raw.title: chore(deps-dev): bump @commitlint/config-conventional from 21.2.0 to 21.2.2
raw.body:
Bumps [@commitlint/config-conventional](https://github.com/conventional-changelog/commitlint/tree/HEAD/@commitlint/config-conventional) from 21.2.0 to 21.2.2.
Release notes

Sourced from @​commitlint/config-conventional's releases.

v21.2.2

21.2.2 (2026-08-13)

Bug Fixes

  • parse: require colon after note keywords (conventional-commits-parser 7.1.2) (#4927) (b83c515), closes conventional-changelog/conventional-changelog#1517
  • fix(container): resolve packages from TypeScript configs by @​Guflly in conventional-changelog/commitlint#4914
  • fix(resolve-extends): support Yarn Plug'n'Play by @​Guflly in conventional-changelog/commitlint#4933

Chore, docs, etc.

  • docs: fix typos in comments and JSDoc by @​maxtaran2010 in conventional-changelog/commitlint#4880
  • docs: fix Deno setup without package.json by @​awnoa in conventional-changelog/commitlint#4896
  • chore: repair broken lockfile from #4939 and add merge queue CI support by @​escapedcat in conventional-changelog/commitlint#4941
  • docs(config-conventional): document rules that go beyond the spec by @​escapedcat in conventional-changelog/commitlint#4910

New Contributors

  • @​maxtaran2010 made their first contribution in conventional-changelog/commitlint#4880
  • @​awnoa made their first contribution in conventional-changelog/commitlint#4896
  • @​Guflly made their first contribution in conventional-changelog/commitlint#4914

Full Changelog: https://github.com/conventional-changelog/commitlint/compare/v21.2.1...v21.2.2

v21.2.1

21.2.0 (2026-06-30)

Features

  • resolve-extends: resolve pure-ESM presets (conventional-changelog v7/v9/v10) (#4859) (fdb566f)

Chore, doc, etc.

  • chore(read): replace deprecated git-raw-commits with git-client by @​igordanchenko in conventional-changelog/commitlint#4860
  • docs(issue-template): ask for package manager and version by @​escapedcat in conventional-changelog/commitlint#4867

New Contributors

  • @​igordanchenko made their first contribution in conventional-changelog/commitlint#4860

Full Changelog: https://github.com/conventional-changelog/commitlint/compare/v21.2.0...v21.2.1
